methods.label: Calculate from left to right
methods.explanation:
Multiplication and division have equal priority, so calculate from left to right:
\[
6 \div 20 \times 100 = 0.3 \times 100 = 30.
\]
6 is \(30\%\) of 20. The result is \(30\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: The calculation uses decimal division and multiplication by 100, both within Grade 6.
